segments.title: Chương 226: Vụ án nhỏ.
segments.content:
Chapter 230: 0227 A Minor Case. Bian Guanyue had mentioned her cousin many times, but Chen Guiliang never imagined their first meeting would be under such circumstances.

Bian Guanyue quickly rushed over to check on the situation.

Chen Guiliang remained seated on the sofa, pulling out his phone to call 120.

The Macallan bottle was of good quality; it hadn't shattered even after being smashed against a forehead.

Or perhaps Qiao Na wasn't very strong.

Because the man hadn't been knocked unconscious either.

Although not unconscious, he was completely dazed.

Luo Jun's head was buzzing. Other than clutching his wound and crying out in pain, he was utterly incapable of doing anything else.

His posse of degenerate friends reacted in various ways.

Some backed away in terror, some stepped forward to question her, but surprisingly, none went to check on his injuries.

"What gives you the right to hit someone?" a man said, pointing at Qiao Na.

Qiao Na had evolved into her mother tiger form. She brandished the bottle and said, "If you dare point at me again, I'll hit you too!"

The bar owner, Jiang Zhiming, crouched down and asked Luo Jun, "Are you okay?"

Luo Jun just kept crouching there wailing, completely unable to answer.

Seeing blood seep through his fingers, Yang Shuo immediately took off his own shirt, forcibly pried Luo Jun's hand away, and pressed the shirt against the wound. He then put Luo Jun's hand back and said, "Hold it down yourself!"

"Hurry, call 120!" Tan Weiwei said.

Chen Guiliang had already walked over. "Already did."

Bian Guanyue stood by Qiao Na's side. She didn't try to mediate, but rather faced the others alongside her cousin. She might not start trouble, but she was just as fiery when it found her.

Qin Shanshan was even more amusing. Enjoying the drama, she excitedly took out her phone to record.

Quite a few other patrons in the bar were also taking photos and videos.

This was far more interesting than drinking, listening to music, or picking up girls.

"How did a fight break out?" Xu Haibo, who had been watching the bartender, finally ran back over.

The police arrived first, as there was a station nearby.

Upon seeing someone was injured, the first thing the officer asked was, "Has 120 been called?"

Chen Guiliang said, "It has."

The officer asked again, "Who threw the punch?"

"Her! She hit him with a bottle," one of Luo Jun's friends said.

The officer said, "Put the bottle down first."

Qiao Na took two steps and planted the bottle on a table.

The officer worked on this street and naturally knew who the owner was. He faced Jiang Zhiming. "Briefly explain the situation."

Jiang Zhiming said, "This Ms. Bian went on stage and sang a song. The injured gentleman, Mr. Luo, insisted on buying her a drink. Ms. Bian refused and returned to her seat with her boyfriend. About twenty minutes later, Mr. Luo came over with a bottle of foreign liquor and insisted on buying a drink for Ms. Bian and her boyfriend."

Two officers had come. Hearing this, they had a pretty good idea of what had happened.

There was more than one bar in the area, and they'd encountered this kind of thing too many times.

Jiang Zhiming continued, "Several people, including myself, asked Mr. Luo to leave and stop harassing Ms. Bian. This gentleman, Mr. Yang, got impatient, grabbed Mr. Luo by the collar, and dragged him from the booth over to here."

The officer asked Yang Shuo, "Did you lay a hand on him?"

Yang Shuo replied, "I didn't hit him, I just dragged him over. He was too annoying, and I didn't want to listen to his bullshit."

The officer then asked Qiao Na, "Why did you hit him?"

Qiao Na said, "I came back to Rongcheng a couple of days ago on business and came to this bar for a drink tonight. I happened to see my cousin being harassed, and I got angry and hit him."

The officer then asked Luo Jun's friends, "Do you have anything to add?"

One man said, "My friend was already leaving them alone. It was this woman who chased him down and hit him."

"Bullshit!"

Qiao Na said, "If this idiot hadn't been harassing her, I wouldn't have even known my cousin was at the bar. It was the commotion over here that made me come over to see what was going on, and that's when I found out what happened."

The officer said to Jiang Zhiming, "Give me the details."

Jiang Zhiming said, "It was like this. Mr. Yang dragged Mr. Luo over here, and I was worried about offending a customer. I said to Mr. Luo, do me a favor tonight, and I'll comp all their drinks. Mr. Luo then started arguing with me. Of course, we didn't get physical, it was just a verbal dispute. As a businessman, I try to smooth things over, but Mr. Luo was being relentless."

Jiang Zhiming pointed at the group of friends. "At that point, Mr. Luo's friends also came over, and the argument got louder. It attracted a lot of patrons to watch, and Ms. Bian's cousin came over around that time."

The officer had now figured out the whole sequence of events and handled it according to routine. He said to Qiao Na in a stern tone, "Even if the other party was at fault first, it's definitely wrong to resort to violence. If it causes injury, you could face jail time in serious cases, or detention in minor ones. Do you understand?"

"Mhm," Qiao Na acknowledged.

The officer then said to Luo Jun's friends, "You all are at fault too. Even though this is a bar, you should still respect others' wishes when you offer to buy them a drink. The young lady already refused, yet you kept harassing her. In serious terms, that's called provoking a disturbance. Do you understand?"

"It has nothing to do with me."

"We weren't harassing them, just offering a drink. That bottle of foreign liquor costs over ten thousand yuan. Who would waste that much money to provoke a disturbance?"

"Officer, I'm an employee of Accenture. Our headquarters are in Ireland."

"The victim, Mr. Luo, also works for a foreign company. He's a senior manager at a British-invested enterprise."

These guys either tried to distance themselves from the incident or used the names of foreign companies to intimidate him.

Many patrons were watching, so the officer adopted an impartial tone. "I don't care where you work. First, wait here for the ambulance. The rest of you, come back with me to give statements. The specific course of action will depend on the extent of the injuries."

He asked some other patrons if they were willing to be witnesses, and several immediately agreed.

The victim, Luo Jun, was no longer wailing, but he remained crouched on the floor, clutching his wound. He felt like he had lost a lot of blood, and his head was fuzzy, still too dizzy to think straight.

The officer led the group outside the bar to wait for the ambulance to arrive.

After a long wait, the ambulance finally came.

One officer accompanied the injured man to the hospital.

The other officer took both parties involved and the witnesses to the station.

The police station was small and understaffed, so they had to wait in line to give their statements.

Qiao Na, Bian Guanyue, Yang Shuo, and Jiang Zhiming were in the first group to go in.

"Name."

"Bian Guanyue. Bian as in border, Guan as in to close, Yue as in moon."

"Age."

"20."

"Sex, female. Place of household registration."

"Rongcheng."

"Occupation."

"Undergraduate student."

"Which university?"

"Capital University of Economics and Business."

"Why are you in Rongcheng?"

"I came back to audition for the Super Girl competition."

"Describe in detail the cause and course of today's incident."

After everything was recorded, the officer handed her the statement. "Read it carefully. If there are no errors, sign it."

Bian Guanyue read it over and briskly signed her name.

The officer added, "Call your parents and have them come over."

Bian Guanyue said, "I'm already an adult."

"You're still a student even if you're an adult," the officer said. "Your cousin injured someone, and there might be compensation involved. If you actively compensate and obtain the injured party's forgiveness, this matter will be easier to resolve. Get your parents here so your family can discuss it properly."

Bian Guanyue said, "That's not necessary."

The officer didn't insist. "Fine, go wait outside. Send your boyfriend in."

Chen Guiliang quickly walked in.

"Name."

"Chen Guiliang. Chen with the 'east' radical. Gui as in noble. Liang as in kind."

"Hm?"

The officer sized up Chen Guiliang. When they had downtime at the station, they would often read the newspaper. The *West China Metropolis Daily* was a required subscription, and Chen Guiliang had appeared in it several times.

The lighting in the bar had been poor; only now did he get a clear look at Chen Guiliang's face.

"The one from Peking University who started a company?"

"That's me."

"What brings you back to Rongcheng?"

"Accompanying my girlfriend to the Super Girl competition."

After a long day's work, the statements of over twenty people were finally completed.

Most of them were allowed to leave, with only the main parties required to stay and wait for news from the hospital.

"Chief, this case is simple, but we need to handle it carefully. On one side, we have five university students and a retired soldier. On the other, four employees from foreign companies and two from state-owned enterprises. Especially that Chen Guiliang, a Peking University student, entrepreneur, and well-known author. A slight misstep and this could blow up."

"Let's wait for news from the hospital. If it's just a minor injury, we should try to get them to settle privately."

"Sigh, these bars. There's a fight every other day."

"It's about time. You and Xiao Wu should go back and get some sleep."

"Then I'll be going."

"Stop wasting time and get out of here!"

After about an hour's wait, the injured Luo Jun also arrived at the station.

It was nothing serious. Three stitches and a minor concussion.

The station chief spoke with Luo Jun privately. "Mr. Luo, how do you plan to handle this? If you're willing to mediate, we can have the other party offer compensation and an apology."

Luo Jun was full of resentment. "I don't want mediation. I want her to go to jail!"

The chief said, "This is classified as a minor injury; she won't go to jail for it. If you insist on handling it according to the law, the woman who hit you will receive an administrative detention of five days and a fine of 500 yuan."

"That's all the punishment she gets?" Luo Jun asked in surprise.

The chief explained, "Lost wages, medical expenses, and so on, are matters for a civil claim. If you refuse mediation, you'll need to sue to get that compensation. I think it's best for both sides to take a step back."

Luo Jun asked, "What does the woman who hit me do for a living?"

"That's private information," the chief said. "Besides, you were also at fault in this matter. You repeatedly harassed the assailant's cousin, Ms. Bian."

"What do you mean, harassed? I was just offering her a drink! Isn't that normal in a bar?"

Luo Jun suddenly realized something. "Did the other side pull some strings? Let me tell you, I'm a senior manager at a British-invested enterprise, and my boss is British. Jones Lang LaSalle was brought in by your government, and it's currently in a growth phase. Me getting injured will seriously affect the company's operations! If this turns into a diplomatic incident, you will be held responsible!"

The chief brought over an old newspaper. "The other party hasn't contacted anyone. I just hope this matter can be resolved amicably. It's for the good of both of you."

The newspaper was opened to a page where the article's photo was clearly of Chen Guiliang signing documents at his B-round financing.

The hint was very obvious, but Luo Jun's attention was on Bian Guanyue. At the bar, he had only scrutinized Chen Guiliang's clothes and didn't remember what he looked like at all.

"I do not agree to mediation. Detain that woman first, we'll talk later!" Luo Jun didn't understand the chief's meaning.

The chief had no choice but to say, "You can all talk it over again face to face."

"There's nothing to talk about," Luo Jun said.

Still, the chief brought both parties together.

Two of Luo Jun's friends, the ones from state-owned enterprises, had already left. They bolted right after giving their statements, wanting no further part in the matter.

With the group sitting together, the chief said to Qiao Na, "The other party has a minor injury. If you can't reach a settlement, you will be detained for a few days."

Bian Guanyue said, "Can I make a phone call?"

"No calls! If you dare make a call, our friendship is over!" Qiao Na yelled.

Chen Guiliang watched them with great interest.

For Chen Guiliang, this whole thing was a trivial matter. He didn't care how it was handled.

Bian Guanyue said, "I can't just watch you get detained, can I?"

"Getting detained is my own business!" Qiao Na's personality was very impulsive, and her temper was foul and stubborn.

Bian Guanyue had already taken out her phone. "Hello, Dad... I'm at the police station... I'm fine. Someone was harassing me, and my cousin injured him... This station is called... The other person's name is Luo Jun, a department director at Jones Lang LaSalle..."

Before Bian Guanyue's dad could arrive, the station chief's phone rang first.

While the chief was still on his call, Luo Jun's phone rang too.

"Hello, Director Zhang, this is Luo..." Luo Jun said.

An enraged voice came through the phone. "I know you're Luo Jun! Are you fucking insane? Why are you provoking one of the company's major clients? And you were harassing his goddamn daughter?"

"Huh? No, Director Zhang, let me explain." Luo Jun was suddenly frantic.

(End of this chapter)
